tools.name: holiday_list
tools.description: List all public holidays for a given country and year. Use this for questions like 'what public holidays does France have in 2026' or 'is there a bank holiday in the UK this month'.

year.description: The calendar year to list holidays for, e.g. 2026

tools.name: holiday_next
tools.description: List the next upcoming public holidays for a given country, starting from today. Use this for questions like 'when is the next public holiday in Germany' or 'what's the next bank holiday'.
